usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.admin.organization.projects.create(name="string", geography="string", external_key_id="string")
print(result)

fields.name: name
fields.description: The friendly name of the project, this name appears in reports.

fields.name: geography
fields.description: Create the project with the specified data residency region. Your organization must have access to Data residency functionality in order to use. See [data residency controls](/docs/guides/your-data#data-residency-controls) to review the functionality and limitations of setting this field.

fields.name: external_key_id
fields.description: External key ID to associate with the project.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.project`

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the project. This appears in reporting.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the project was created.

fields.name: external_key_id
fields.description: The external key associated with the project.
